evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Technical rollback-readiness compressed into a plain, aphoristic maxim — jargon-free rendering of an operational claim as a memorable rule.

mints.name: RuleAsMatchedOpposition
mints.title: crystallize a rule into matched opposed clauses
mints.frame: Is the expression performing a rule as a balanced opposition — the same noun-phrase on both sides, negated — to make it memorable and binding?
